105    protected static function addBankCodeChecksum($iban, $countryCode = 'PL')
106    {
107        if ($countryCode != 'PL' || strlen($iban) <= 8) {
108            return $iban;
109        }
110        $checksum = 0;
111        $weights = [7, 1, 3, 9, 7, 1, 3];
112
113        for ($i = 0; $i < 7; ++$i) {
114            $checksum += $weights[$i] * (int) $iban[$i];
115        }
116        $checksum = $checksum % 10;
117
118        return substr($iban, 0, 7) . $checksum . substr($iban, 8);
119    }
